第1章(1)
“大鱼……我真的觉得或许应该会有更好的办法。”罗曼曼不安的跟在好友言待榆的身后，试图让她放弃这个主意。
“觉得、或许、应该，你有三个不确定的用词，所以请闭嘴。”言待榆头也不回道。
“可是他要是生气怎么办？”罗曼曼愈想愈不妥，手抓着好友的衣服，不让她再向前一步。
“罗曼曼！快放手，不然我要揍人了。”言待榆转身瞪她一眼──罗曼曼不支持就算了，居然还想阻止她的复仇行动。
“我是怕到时候惹出麻烦来。”罗曼曼胆怯的紧抓着言待榆的上衣，不让她前进，“要是他生气，对你动粗，那该怎么办？”
言待榆扳开紧抓着衣服的手，“我还真怕他不生气呢！”她随意拍拍好友的肩安抚道：“不会有事的。”
探头探脑的在一家店门前观察一会儿，手招了两下，“是不是中间那个穿浅蓝色衬衫的家伙？”
“大鱼，算了啦！好不好？”
言待榆转过身，面色显得异常严肃，“罗曼曼！我们做人不能这么没志气吧？”
罗曼曼很为难的看着好友小声道：“偶尔……没志气没关系吧？”
“罗曼曼──”她怎么会有这种窝囊的朋友？
“好啦……”罗曼曼不甘不愿的附和，“做人要有志气。”
“你看那个负心汉，你为他哭了多久、浪费了多少青春，可他却悠哉的看报纸、喝咖啡，这有道理吗？你说！”
“没道理。”
“是吧！没这种道理。”
“那……见好就收哟？”
“好，见血就收。”说完看到罗曼曼倒抽一口气，脸上明显有着惊恐神色，言待榆这才翻翻白眼，“开玩笑的。”这朋友还真是很没幽默感。
“大鱼──”
“放心、放心，你乖乖在这里等着，相机准备好了没？记得要把他的蠢样给拍下来，回去再慢慢嘲笑。”

“我尽量。”罗曼曼有些紧张的抿唇。
言待榆拿出准备好的眼药水点了两滴，让眼眶泛着水气后推门走进店内。
“小姐，请问有订位吗？”服务生亲切的问着来人。
“我……我来找人。”言待榆低着头，小声的说。
“需要帮忙广播吗？”服务生看她胆小，也放柔了声音。
“不、不用，我看到了。”言待榆怯生生的走到目标前，不发一语，只是瞅着正闲适看报的男人。
温雅的男人抬起头，看着一名陌生女子正用着红通通的眼睛望着自己，露出微笑，“请问有什么事吗？”
“你怎么可以这样？”才说一句，言待榆的眼泪已扑簌簌的流了下来，“你这个负心汉，你怎么可以背着我跟别的女人乱搞？”她沙哑的道。
“小姐，你是不是认错人了？”男人柔声问道。
“是了，你现在就不认识我了。”她吸吸鼻子，“我……我为了你还拿掉孩子，现在你有新欢就翻脸不认人。呜……”手捂着脸，发出微弱的哭声。
店里指责的眼光全往男人投射，他拧紧眉心，一脸的为难样，“小姐，你真的认错人了。”
“我已经被家人赶出来了。”她突然抓住他的手，“我已经无处可去了，你说我该怎么办……”紧咬着唇，模样极为凄楚可怜。
“或许你可以找一些社会救助机构来帮你。”男人耐着性子道。
“阿则……你不要抛弃我，我只剩下你了，呜……”
“小姐，你认错人了，我不叫阿则。”
哼！只说一句他不是阿则就想摆脱她吗？笑话，她大鱼哪是这么简单的角色。“阿则，你不要这样，我仍然爱你，你回来好不好？”作势要哭倒在地上，不料男人却快她一步的将她抓着。
“阿则，你要回来吗？”她哑着嗓问，同时打量着眼前的男人──他俊雅的外表让她不自觉的屏住气息，看他一双温润的黑眸正瞅着她，言待榆不自在的低下头，也暗叹着对方的魅力，难怪罗曼曼会被他迷得昏天暗地；但就算他再迷人，遇到她大鱼，也只能算他倒霉！
“这位先生，做人要有责任感，你就好好跟小姐谈一谈。”有人看不下去，开始仗义出声。
“阿则的本性很好，他只是一时迷惑。”言待榆小声的为“情郎”解释。
周遭不满的声音愈来愈多，言待榆的内心简直快笑翻了──敢欺负她大鱼的麻吉，她当然不会让他这么好过。

“不……不好意思！”
突然，言待榆听到一记怯弱的声音，瞄了一眼，果然是罗曼曼，她该不会是心软想破坏计划吧？
“这位先生，真的很不好意思，我姊姊她……脑袋不正常，姊姊，我们回家了。”罗曼曼对着言待榆眨眼暗示着。
“明明就是他搞大了我的肚子，又去跟别的女人上床，我是哪里不正常了？”言待榆哽咽道。
罗曼曼小声的在言待榆耳边道：“你认错人了！”看她怔了一下，拉拉她的手，“姊姊，我们先回家休息，不哭、不哭。”
认错人了？！
言待榆脸一僵，看到方才那个被错认的倒霉男人正盯着她看，她立刻将悲苦的神色藏起来，取而代之的则是迷蒙加困惑的表情，“把拔，我好想你，你怎么不回家？”压扁了声音，就像是小孩说话一样。
“真的很不好意思。”罗曼曼弯腰道歉，再看向言待榆，“他不是阿则，也不是把拔，走，我带你去找阿则，我们回家啰？”身后议论纷纷的声音让罗曼曼感到很不自在，她一说完便拉着好友离开。
走出店外，言待榆的眼泪一收，直接将罗曼曼拖到隔壁的巷内，“你给我说清楚，不是穿蓝衣服的那个人吗？”
“你认错人了，阿则坐在那个人后面一桌。”
言待榆拧眉，认真的回想着，“你说的该不会是那个长得肉肉的、胖胖的，还戴着眼镜的──肉包吧？”
“阿则那是壮！”罗曼曼对于好友的形容词很有意见。
言待榆倒抽一口气，简直不敢相信好友的盲目，一脸受到严重打击道：“你竟然被肉包劈腿！你当初是怎么跟我说的？说他长得斯文又俊俏？”
“嗯啊……他是长得很俊俏……”罗曼曼不安的绞着手指，人家她是真的如此认为。
“稳重？”
“很稳啊……”
“罗曼曼，我真的会被你给气死！”言待榆没好气的瞪着好友，“你是看上他的家产吗？”如果是的话，那她可以暂时原谅罗曼曼的眼光。
“我才不是那种人！你不觉得他看起来很有安全感吗？”抱起来也很舒服，只要他少流汗的话……
“劈了两个，真是好安全啊！”言待榆手戳着罗曼曼的脑袋。
罗曼曼垂下肩，不发一语。

言待榆看到好友一脸的颓丧样，只得无奈叹道：“好啦、好啦！对不起，是我说得太过分了。”
“不要紧。”罗曼曼偷觑她一眼，“倒是刚才害你丢脸了。”
“没差这一次。”她大鱼有的是义气，再来就是脸皮够厚。
“那现在该怎么办？”
“回去再商讨对策，大仇择日再报。”
“啊……”
“啊什么？我再说一次，我们做人可是要有志气！”她说完一个转身，立刻撞上一堵肉墙，正想破口大骂，却惊觉来人正是刚才的无辜受害者，吓了一跳，急忙装傻道：“把、把拔，你这怎么来了？”
“我不是要找你算帐的，你不用担心。”男人笑得温暖，语气中有着包容。

Chapter 1(1)
"Big Fish... I really think there might be a better way." Luo Manman followed her friend Yan Dingyu uneasily, trying to get her to give up the idea.
"I think, maybe, should, you have three uncertain words, so please shut up." Yan Zaiyu replied without even turning his head.
"But what if he gets angry?" The more Romanman thought about it, the more inappropriate it became. He grabbed his friend's clothes to prevent her from taking another step forward.
"Romanman! Let go, or I'm going to beat him up." Yan Daiyu turned around and glared at her - even if Romanman didn't support him, he actually wanted to stop her revenge.
"I'm afraid I'll cause trouble then." Romanman timidly held on to Yan Taiyu's shirt to prevent her from moving forward. "What if he gets angry and uses force on you?"
Yan Daiyu pulled away the hand that was holding the clothes tightly, "I'm really afraid that he won't be angry!" She casually patted her friend's shoulder and reassured him, "It'll be okay."
He peered in front of a store for a while and waved twice, "Is that the guy in the light blue shirt in the middle?"
"Big fish, forget it! Okay?"
Yan Daiyu turned around, his expression extremely serious, "Romanman! We can't be so unambitious, right?"
Romanman looked at his friend in embarrassment and whispered: "Occasionally...it doesn't matter if you don't have ambition, right?"
"Romanman──" How could she have such a useless friend?
"Okay..." Romanman agreed reluctantly, "You must be ambitious in life."
"Look at that heartless man. How long have you been crying for him and how much youth you have wasted, but he is leisurely reading newspapers and drinking coffee. Does this make sense? Tell me!"
"It doesn't make sense."
"Really! That doesn't make sense."
"Then...just accept it as soon as you see fit?"
"Okay, stop when you see blood." After saying that, he saw Luo Manman gasping, with a look of horror on his face. Yan Daiyu rolled his eyes and said, "You're kidding." This friend really has no sense of humor.
"Big fish──"
"Don't worry, don't worry. Just wait here obediently. Is your camera ready? Remember to take a picture of his stupidity and laugh at him slowly when he gets back."
"I'll try my best." Roman Man pursed his lips nervously.
Yan Daiyu took out the prepared eye drops and put on two drops, then opened the door and walked into the store with moisture in his eyes.
"Miss, do you have a reservation?" the waiter asked the visitor cordially.
"I...I'm looking for someone." Yan Daiyu lowered his head and said softly.
"Do you need help with the broadcast?" The waiter saw that she was timid and softened his voice.
"No, no need, I saw it." Yan Daiyu walked timidly to the target, without saying a word, just looking at the man who was leisurely reading the newspaper.
The gentle man raised his head and saw a strange woman looking at him with red eyes, smiling, "Excuse me, what can I do?"
"How could you do this?" As soon as she said this, Yan Daiyu's tears were already streaming down her face. "You heartless man, how could you go behind my back and fuck with other women?" she said hoarsely.
"Miss, did you admit the wrong person?" the man asked softly.
"That's right, you don't recognize me now." She sniffed, "I... I took away the child for you, and now you have a new love and you turn your back on me. Oh..." She covered her face with her hands and let out a weak cry.
All the accusing eyes in the store were directed at the man. He frowned and said with an embarrassed look on his face, "Miss, you really got the wrong person."
"I have been kicked out by my family." She suddenly grabbed his hand, "I have nowhere to go, what do you think I should do..." She bit her lip, looking extremely pitiful.
"Perhaps you can find some social assistance agencies to help you." The man said patiently.
"Aze...don't abandon me, I only have you left, ugh..."
"Miss, you have recognized the wrong person. My name is not Aze."
Hum!Do you want to get rid of her just by saying that he is not Aze? What a joke, how can she be such a simple character? "Aze, don't be like this. I still love you. Can you come back?" She was about to cry and fall to the ground, but unexpectedly the man caught her one step ahead of her.
"Aze, are you coming back?" she asked in a hoarse voice, while sizing up the man in front of her - his handsome appearance made her hold her breath unconsciously, seeing his warm black eyes looking at her, Yan Taiyu lowered his head uncomfortably, and secretly sighed at the charm of the other person. No wonder Romanman would be so fascinated by him; but no matter how charming he is, if he meets her, he can only be considered unlucky!
"Sir, you have to have a sense of responsibility as a person, so you should have a good talk with the lady." Some people couldn't stand it anymore and began to speak up.
"Aze's nature is very good, he was just confused for a moment." Yan Daiyu explained to his "lover" in a low voice.
There were more and more voices of dissatisfaction around her, and Yan Taiyu almost burst out laughing in her heart - Mo Ji dared to bully her Da Yu, of course she would not make it so easy for him.
"No...sorry!"
Suddenly, Yan Taiyu heard a timid voice and glanced at it. Sure enough, it was Luo Manman. Could she be soft-hearted and want to sabotage the plan?
"Sir, I'm really sorry. My sister... is not in her right mind. Sister, let's go home." Luo Manman hinted with a wink at Yan Danyu.
"Obviously it was him who made me pregnant and went to bed with another woman. What's wrong with me?" Yan Daiyu choked with sobs.
Luo Manman whispered in Yan Daiyu's ear: "You have recognized the wrong person!" Seeing her stunned for a moment, he pulled her hand and said, "Sister, let's go home and rest first. Don't cry, don't cry."
Wrong person? !
Yan Daiyu's face froze, and when she saw the unlucky man who had been mistakenly identified just now was staring at her, she immediately hid her miserable expression, and replaced it with a hazy and confused expression, "Baba, I miss you so much, why don't you go home?" She suppressed her voice, just like a child talking.
"I'm really sorry." Romanman bent down to apologize, then looked at Yan Taiyu, "He is not Aze, and he is not Baba. Let's go, I will take you to find Aze, shall we go home?" The chatter behind her made Romanman feel very uncomfortable. As soon as she finished speaking, she pulled her friend away.
After walking out of the store, Yan Daiyu stopped crying and dragged Luo Manman to the alley next door. "Please tell me clearly, isn't he the man in blue?"
"You got the wrong person. Ze is sitting at the table behind that person."
Yan Daiyu frowned and thought carefully, "Are you talking about the fleshy, fat guy with glasses—the meat bun?"
"Azena is so strong!" Luo Manman was very dissatisfied with the adjectives used by his friends.
Yan Daiyu took a breath and couldn't believe his friend's blindness. He said with a seriously shocked look on his face: "You were cheated on by a meat bag! What did you tell me in the first place? That he was elegant and handsome?"
"Yeah...he is very handsome..." Romanman wringed her fingers uneasily, she really thought so.
"Steady?"
"It's very stable..."
"Romanman, I will really be pissed off by you!" Yan Taiyu glared at his friend angrily, "Are you interested in his family property?" If so, then she could temporarily forgive Romanman's look.
"I'm not that kind of person! Don't you think he looks very safe?" It's also very comfortable to hold, as long as he doesn't sweat less...
"Cut two of them, it's so safe!" Yan Daiyu poked Luo Manman's head with his hand.
Romanman lowered his shoulders and said nothing.
Seeing the dejected look on his friend's face, Yan Taiyu had no choice but to sigh: "Okay, okay! I'm sorry, I said too much."
"It doesn't matter." Romanman glanced at her secretly, "I just embarrassed you."
"I won't miss it this time." She has a big fish.It's loyalty, and the second thing is being thick-skinned.
"What should we do now?"
"We will discuss countermeasures when we go back, and we will avenge ourselves someday."
"Ah..."
"Ah what? Let me say it again, we must be ambitious as human beings!" After she finished speaking, she turned around and immediately ran into a wall of flesh. Just as she was about to yell, she was surprised to realize that the person coming was the innocent victim just now. She was startled and hurriedly pretended to be stupid: "B-Bang, why are you here?"
"I'm not here to settle a score with you, so don't worry." The man smiled warmly, with tolerance in his tone.
